description:
Reports whether the source RecordSet of a grid session has changes that the grid has not picked up yet. Clients use this to decide whether to prompt the user to synchronize (PULL).

When hasChanges is false, a PULL would change nothing. When hasChanges is true, a PULL may still change nothing: for example a CSV that was re-saved with different bytes but the same rows is reported as a DATA change.

gridSessionId.description: The sessionId of the grid session this status was computed for.

sourceEntityId.description: The synId of the source RecordSet this grid session was created from.

baselineVersionNumber.description: The source RecordSet version the grid was last synchronized to, as recorded on the session's sourceEntityVersionNumber. Null when the session has no baseline.

currentVersionNumber.description: The current version number of the source RecordSet.

hasChanges.description: True when the source RecordSet has at least one change the grid has not picked up, i.e. when changes is not empty.

changes.description: Each way in which the source RecordSet differs from the revision the grid was last synchronized to. Empty when there are no changes.
